entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm a bit confused. I have this helmet I bought, and I think I need to return it. The website was a little overwhelming. I'm not sure what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, I think so. It's VF-881-209. I hope that's right. I'm just looking at my email.
Got it. I see the order for the Pro-Ride Helmet here. Just so I can direct you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, it's not broken. The box is still unopened, actually. It's just... the color isn't quite what I expected from the pictures online. It looked like a brighter red, but it's more of a maroon.
I see. So the color wasn't what you were hoping for.

Right. And for safety, you know, I wanted something really visible on the trails. This just feels too dark. I don't know the rules, it's been a little while since it arrived. Can't you just help me? I'm lost here.
Of course, that's what I'm here for. Let me check the delivery date... Okay, I see it was delivered 52 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Oh, 52 days? Is that bad? I really didn't realize it was that long.

Not at all. You're well within our 90-day return window for the helmet. Since the box is unopened and it's in original condition, I can go ahead and approve this return for you right now. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account.
Oh, really? That's it? That's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much, Diana.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
